title: Deseos retrospectivos y lamentos pasados con '¡Ojalá!'
goal: Deploy '¡Ojalá!' followed by pluperfect subjunctive to express retrospective past wishes, regrets, and unfulfilled nostalgic longings.
grammar: oraciones desiderativas retrospectivas independientes con ¡Ojalá! y pluscuamperfecto de subjuntivo

items: Formulate retrospective regrets and nostalgic lamentations with '¡Ojalá hubiera/hubiese!'.
Distinguish present wishes (imperfect) from unfulfilled past regrets (pluperfect).
Evaluate emotional stances of remorse and wistfulness in authentic discourse.
